# Awesome Fable 5.5 Videos

[English](README.md) · [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Viral videos made with **Fable 5.5** — animations, games, 3D scenes and long-form shorts rendered entirely from code (HTML, Canvas, SVG, Three.js and friends). Every entry links to the creator's original post and, where the creator shared it, the prompt behind it.

## How to use a prompt

1. Open a prompt file and copy the block under **Prompt**.
2. Paste it into Fable 5.5 (or any agent running it) and ask for the result as a single HTML file.
3. Record the page if you want a video.

Some creators shared only part of their prompt, or only described the result in their post; those files say so.
